title: LLM isolation X5: each phase reads an artifact index with read grants; deliverables and lineage lessons stay reachable on demand
summary: The sandbox grants reads of the whole repo and $HOME (go/internal/adapters/sandbox/sandbox.go:164-182). Raw logs sit in the workspace (go/internal/bridge/engine.go:341, driver_tmux_prepare.go:69). The operator, 2026-10-25: earlier deliverables and the retry and recovery lessons must be "accessible when needed (not necessary to be loaded at the beginning)". Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §8 and §9.
fix: Write <ws>/inputs/index.json before each launch (spec §8.3): earlier deliverables of the cycle, and for a retry or recovery the lineage (lane-scope.json todo_ids and the continuation chain, capped by isolation.lineage_max). Grant reads of exactly the indexed paths; deny other .evolve/runs reads, raw output (logs move to <ws>/.bridge/) and $HOME secrets; allow manifest home_reads. Personas open index entries instead of fixed workspace paths. Handoff asks travel as an index entry.
acceptance: RED first: a retry attempt can open its predecessor's retrospective-report.md (row N6) and cannot open an unrelated cycle's audit-report.md (row N7); today both reads pass
Row N5: a cell cannot read <ws>/.bridge/scout-stdout.log
Row N8: a cell cannot read ~/.ssh; a contract row proves the Claude OAuth login through the Keychain still works
The index lists no raw output; TestLineageComesOnlyFromPipelineRecords pins the lineage sources
Nothing from the index is preloaded into the prompt beyond the index itself
In shadow each denied read emits ISOLATION_I5_VIOLATION or ISOLATION_I4_VIOLATION and passes
Changed functions at 100% coverage; the personas, spec §8 and §9 and the core and sandbox package notes updated
